title: Image usage accounting gets more accurate
summary:
Image accounting and request controls got a closer look, while the API docs and community project directory grew.

GPT Image now reports actual output-token usage instead of a fixed one-token count. Pricing records were also corrected for nanobanana, seedream, kontext, and turbo, along with the free or paid status of several models.

Kontext now requires seed-tier authentication or higher and has tier-based request and concurrency limits. Image queues can size themselves to each model's concurrency cap rather than a hardcoded limit. GPTImage also gained automated controls for accounts with a sustained pattern of failed requests.

The API documentation now starts with a quick start and builds toward advanced use, with expanded Python, JavaScript, and cURL examples for text, image, and audio. The Pollen FAQ also clarifies what different API keys can access today and separates current capabilities from launch goals.
